First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow Poke Ride from St Matthews Church group ride

Slow Poke Ride from St Matthews Church is a road group ride in Portland, OR. It rolls every Thursday at 10:00 am from St Matthew’s Anglican Church.

A slow, flat 20-mile Thursday ride into Northeast Portland at 10–12 mph, with a break at Guilder Coffee Company (72nd and Prescott). The club posts it every week, next to its Monday and Friday ‘meander’ rides.
